The Cypress Collection™ was born out of shame. For nearly a decade, we’ve made the mistake of putting our charitable goals ahead of the craftsmanship of our products - often slapping our logo onto down-market merchandise instead of taking the time to design real clothing from scratch.

That’s why we’ve entered a New Era of Summit Ice™. With the launch of the Cypress Collection™, the practice of putting Holocaust awareness ahead of quality has come to an end. We’re proud to introduce a technical shell and premium insulated jacket with industry-leading 20K/20K waterproof and breathability ratings. These are jackets for drizzles to downpours, or just looking cool in general in no rain. Free of harmful PFAS, no corners have been cut.
